A '''memory dome''' was a type of [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] item. At some point during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[E1-6RA]] placed several memory domes over a meal that was intended for consumption by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]].
